title: Microsoft 365 outage hits Outlook and Teams
label: Breaking news

scenes.say: A hundred and thirty thousand Outlook reports, and still no time for a full fix. Microsoft three sixty five went down worldwide.
title: 130,000 REPORTS
NO ETA

scenes.say: It started on Thursday, the twelfth of November, at one twenty six in the afternoon, Eastern time. That is per Microsoft's own incident record.
title: WHEN IT BEGAN
scenes.label: Thursday, 12 November

scenes.say: Outlook took the worst of it. Microsoft also listed Teams, SharePoint, Copilot and Defender X D R as affected.
title: WHAT BROKE

scenes.say: Microsoft says it was not a traffic spike. Some servers went unexpectedly unavailable, and that strained the rest. It paused deployments, moved traffic, and is reverting a recent network change.
title: MICROSOFT SAYS

scenes.say: Microsoft says there's no indication of a cyber attack. The root cause is not confirmed yet, and there's no time for full recovery.
If your email is on Microsoft three sixty five, the problem is on their side. Don't reinstall Outlook. Teams chat and meetings mostly worked. Expect apps to come back slowly.
title: WHAT TO DO

scenes.say: Watch the Microsoft three sixty five status account for the all clear, then the post incident review for the real cause.
title: WHAT TO WATCH
scenes.label: then the root cause

scenes.say: My take: keep a plan B, a second chat channel and a contacts list outside the same suite. Full sources are on my blog. Follow for the news that matters, every day.
title: NEWS THAT MATTERS
EVERY DAY
